October 17, 2026


Cameco's annual community tour gives us an opportunity to spend time together in community, listening, learning and continuing to build strong relationships. From October 5 to 8, representatives from Cameco,[Orano](https://facebook.com/35158880592) ,[Ya'thi Néné Lands and Resources](https://facebook.com/136821083427192) visited communities across Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin. The visits, which included a science fair, community dinner and student awards, allowed us to connect with community members and share updates on community programs, operational activities and progress under the Ya'thi Néné Collaboration Agreement. The[Athabasca Denesuline Education Authority](https://facebook.com/103884791261715) also joined the tour to recognize recipients of the Athabasca Student Awards Program. Congratulations to all recipients of the Athabasca Student Awards and Marsi Cho to everyone for the wonderful hospitality![#CommunityTour](https://facebook.com/hashtag/CommunityTour)[#AthabascaBasin](https://facebook.com/hashtag/AthabascaBasin)[#IndigenousPartnerships](https://facebook.com/hashtag/IndigenousPartnerships)
